title: Aid to Capacity Evaluation
instructions: Structured aid for assessing decision-specific capacity to consent to a specific medical decision.

domains.title: Able to understand medical problem
prompts: What problems are you having right now?
What problem is bothering you most?
Why are you in the hospital?
Do you have [name problem here]?

domains.title: Able to understand proposed treatment
prompts: What is the treatment for [your problem]?
What else can we do to help you?
Can you have [proposed treatment]?

domains.title: Able to understand alternative to proposed treatment (if any)
domains.text: Able to understand alternative to proposed treatment
prompts: Are there any other [treatments]?
What other options do you have?
Can you have [alternative treatment]?

domains.title: Able to understand option of refusing proposed treatment
domains.text: Able to understand option of refusing proposed treatment
domains.note: Includes withholding or withdrawing the proposed treatment.
prompts: Can you refuse [proposed treatment]?
Can we stop [proposed treatment]?

domains.title: Able to appreciate reasonably foreseeable consequences of accepting
domains.text: Able to appreciate reasonably foreseeable consequences of accepting
prompts: What could happen to you if you have [proposed treatment]?
Can [proposed treatment] cause problems/side effects?
Can [proposed treatment] help you live longer?

domains.title: Able to appreciate reasonably foreseeable consequences of refusing
domains.text: Able to appreciate reasonably foreseeable consequences of refusing
prompts: What could happen to you if you do not have [proposed treatment]?
Could you get sicker/die if you do not have [proposed treatment]?
What could happen if you have [alternative treatment]? (if alternatives are available)

domains.title: Decision affected by depression
domains.note: YES = decision IS affected by depression. Look for hopelessness, worthlessness, guilt, or punishment themes.
prompts: Can you help me understand why you have decided to accept/refuse treatment?
Do you feel that you are being punished?
Do you think you are a bad person?
Do you have any hope for the future?
Do you deserve to be treated?

domains.title: Decision affected by delusions/psychosis
domains.note: YES = decision IS affected by psychosis or delusion.
prompts: Can you help me understand why you have decided to accept/refuse treatment?
Do you think anyone is trying to hurt/harm you?
Do you trust your doctor/nurse?

report.heading: Aid to Capacity Evaluation (ACE)
report.scoring_note: Capacity is decision-specific. People are presumed capable; if uncertain, err on the side of capable.
